input.quote: (c) ASSIGNMENT. Licensee may not assign this Agreement or assign, sublicense and/or transfer in any manner its license rights hereunder in whole or in part without Licensor's prior written consent.
input.rationale: This sits in walk-away territory on two counts: Article XXIV(c) is a blanket prohibition on Licensee assignment with no affiliate or M&A carve-out and no reciprocal restriction on Licensor, and Article XX(a) automatically terminates the Agreement and all of our licences on our Change of Control unless Licensor consents (with Licensor deemed reasonable in refusing on competitive or self-interest grounds). It therefore fails the fallback (no mutual successor-assignment right) as well as the preferred position. The redline adds our consent-free Affiliate/successor carve-out, subjects Licensor's assignment to our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and bars assignment to our competitors, and removes the change-of-control termination right while leaving the "CHANGE OF CONTROL" definition and Article XX(b) intact. Note separately that the Article XXII right of first refusal on a sale/merger remains and is addressed under the ROFR/MFN rule, not here.

proposal.summary: Add Licensee affiliate/successor assignment carve-out, restrict Licensor assignment, and remove automatic termination on Licensee change of control.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We need to be able to assign to an Affiliate or an M&A successor without consent, and our change of control cannot terminate the Agreement or give Licensor a termination right. We have also made Licensor's assignment subject to our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and barred assignment to our competitors; a mutual successor-assignment-on-notice construct is our fallback.

ops.newText: Licensor may not assign this Agreement without Licensee's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, and may not assign to a competitor of Licensee.

ops.oldText: (a) Upon the occurrence of any Change of Control (as defined below) this Agreement and all Licensee's rights and licenses hereunder shall automatically terminate unless, prior to the occurrence of such Change of Control, Licensor has consented to such Change of Control in a writing executed by an officer of Licensor; provided that Licensor will not unreasonably withhold its consent to the consummation of a Change of Control. For purposes of the preceding sentence, Licensor will be deemed to have reasonably withheld its consent to a Change of Control if any person or entity who would acquire direct or indirect control (as defined below) of Licensee pursuant to such Change of Control then conducts a business that is directly or indirectly competitive with a business then conducted by Licensor or any of its Affiliates and/or Licensor reasonably believes that Licensor's interests will be adversely effected by the continuing of this Agreement upon such a Change in Control.
ops.newText: (a) A Change of Control (as defined below) shall not terminate this Agreement or any of Licensee's rights or licenses hereunder and shall give Licensor no right to terminate this Agreement.
